01_gas_and_liquid_times.png.EN: One-dimensional diffusion steps with no membrane or reaction. (A) Exact bottom concentration for the confirmed 8.929 mm liquid depth at three assumed liquid diffusivities. The surface is fixed immediately; this is not measured cell response. (B) An isolated 3.571 mm gas layer, with its mouth instantly fixed and its bottom impermeable, has t90 approximately 1.315 s at zero velocity and assumed D=10⁻5 m²/s. It excludes upstream wash-in and liquid uptake; it is not the approximately 149 s inlet-to-rim CFD result. The panels have different time units.
01_gas_and_liquid_times.png.ZH: 無膜、無反應的一維擴散階躍。(A) 已確認8.929 mm液柱在三個假設液相擴散係數下的井底解析解；液面瞬間固定，並非實測細胞反應。(B) 孤立3.571 mm氣層，井口濃度瞬間固定、底部不可穿透；零氣速、假設D=10⁻5 m²/s時t90約1.315秒。它不含上游換氣與液體吸收，不是入口到井口約149秒的CFD結果。兩圖時間單位不同。

02_depth_and_mixing.png.EN: Sensitivity to liquid-path assumptions. (A) Bottom t90 scales quadratically with fill volume at fixed11.2mm² area; only100µL is the confirmed operating condition. (B) Effective liquid D multipliers are mixing proxies, not computed flow. The100µm film uses assumed D_PDMS=10⁻10m²/s,K_PDMS=100,K_liquid=10. Membrane resistance becomes more visible when liquid transport is faster.
02_depth_and_mixing.png.ZH: 液體路徑敏感度。(A) 固定11.2 mm²截面時井底t90隨液量平方增加；只有100 µL為已確認條件。(B) 有效D倍數只是混合代理，不是已求解流場。100 µm膜使用假設D膜=10⁻10 m²/s、K膜=100、K液=10；液相變快後，膜阻力的重要性上升。

03_intrinsic_PDMS.png.EN: Bulk solution–diffusion screening over25–500µm, not a selected film. (A) Time lag L²/(6D) for assumed PDMS diffusivities. This lag is not bottom-cell t90. (B) Concentration-based permeance DK/L at D=10⁻10m²/s and four assumed dimensionless PDMS/gas partition ratios. Surface resistance, swelling and mixed-species effects are excluded from these intrinsic curves.
03_intrinsic_PDMS.png.ZH: 25–500 µm體相溶解–擴散敏感度，不是膜選型結果。(A) 假設D下的L²/(6D)延遲，不等於井底t90。(B) D=10⁻10 m²/s、四個假設PDMS／氣相K下的濃度型導度DK/L。此圖未納入表面阻力、膨潤與混合物效應。

04_PDMS_coupled_sweep.png.EN: Bottom t90 for a PDMS–gas–liquid stack at100µL,D_liquid=10⁻9m²/s,K_liquid=10. (A) K_PDMS/gas=1. (B) K_PDMS/gas=100. Rows are assumed PDMS diffusivity; columns are membrane thickness. Cell numbers are hours; gray cells did not reach90% within168h. These are illustrative inputs, not measured properties of a VOC or curing ratio.
04_PDMS_coupled_sweep.png.ZH: 100 µL、D液=10⁻9 m²/s、K液=10的PDMS–氣體–液體疊層井底t90。(A) K膜/氣=1；(B) K膜/氣=100。列為假設膜D，欄為厚度，格內數字為小時；灰格表示168小時仍未達90%。不能將這些假設對應成某VOC或固化配比的量測值。

05_pulse_and_storage.png.EN: A20-minute prescribed gas pulse in the representative100µL stack. (A) Bottom concentration normalized by K_liquid times input gas concentration; the broad peak occurs after the input has ended. (B) Reversible PDMS inventory divided by input gas concentration, reported as gas-equivalent volume per well. D_PDMS=10⁻10m²/s,D_liquid=10⁻9m²/s,K_liquid=10. No irreversible adsorption or receptor adaptation is modeled.
05_pulse_and_storage.png.ZH: 代表性100 µL疊層的20分鐘指定氣體脈衝。(A) 井底濃度除以K液乘輸入氣相濃度，峰值可在停氣後才出現。(B) 可逆PDMS儲存量除以輸入氣相濃度，換成每井氣相等效體積。D膜=10⁻10、D液=10⁻9 m²/s、K液=10；未模擬不可逆吸附或受體適應。

06_oxygen_capacity.png.EN: Illustrative oxygen-transport capacity at293K, not a viability prediction. Published reference PDMS P/D are combined with assumed liquid D=2×10⁻9m²/s and surface O2=0.30mol/m³. (A) Maximum steady supply to a zero-concentration bottom. (B) Constant-demand bottom fraction for100µm PDMS; curves terminate when assumed demand reaches transport capacity. Loads are not measured HEK293T respiration rates; gas/medium control and37°C conditions are not validated.
06_oxygen_capacity.png.ZH: 293 K氧傳遞容量示例，不是存活預測。引用PDMS P／D配合假設液相D=2×10⁻9 m²/s與液面溶氧0.30 mol/m³。(A) 井底濃度為零時的最大穩態供給。(B) 100 µm膜下固定耗氧負載的井底比例，曲線在容量上限停止。負載不是HEK293T實測耗氧；氣體、培養液與37°C控制未經驗證。

07_numerical_validation.png.EN: Implementation checks. (A) Spatial refinement of membrane time lag and liquid-bottom t90 against analytical solutions. (B) Representative100µm PDMS–gas–liquid model with1mL/min mixed-reservoir feed;48→96 liquid cells changes t90 by approximately0.00405%. Time evolution uses a matrix exponential. Small numerical error does not validate assumed material properties or biological performance.
07_numerical_validation.png.ZH: 程式數值檢查。(A) 膜延遲與液柱井底t90對解析解的空間細化誤差。(B) 100 µm膜、1 mL/min混合氣腔供氣代表例，48→96液體格的t90變化約0.00405%。時間採矩陣指數；小數值誤差不代表物性假設或生物效能已驗證。
